settingsSelfService.letVolunteersWithoutAnAccount: Let volunteers without an account take an item into their custody, or return it, by scanning its QR code on their own phone. They enter the workspace PIN, then pick their name from your non-registered members or add it. Owners, Administrators and Managers are emailed about every take and return.
settingsSelfService.setAPinBelowBefore: Set a PIN below before turning self-service on.
settingsSelfService.text4To8DigitsShared: 4 to 8 digits, shared with volunteers at their briefing. Changing it signs every volunteer phone out, so they need the new PIN on their next scan.
settingsSelfService.forItemsWhoseQrLabel: For items whose QR label is missing or hard to reach. Volunteers open the link below, enter the PIN and say who they are. They can take any available item that has the chosen tag or is stored in one of the chosen locations, and return items they hold themselves.

settingsSelfService.choosingALocationIncludesAll: Choosing a location includes all its sub-locations. An item is listed when it has the tag or is in one of these locations. With no tag and no location, the list offers nothing.
